title: HUD layout (mic + meter + status + buttons)
description:

Goal

Deliverables
- Left mic button (icon)
- Center: status label
- Meter widget (fake animated)
- Right: minimize + close buttons

Definition of Done

## Acceptance Criteria
- Clicking mic toggles Idle <-> Listening (mock state)
- Fake meter animates only when `Listening`

2. Fake meter animates only when in `Listening`.

title: Vendor whisper.cpp + OpenBLAS CMake build + Rust FFI wiring
description:
Goal
- Vendor and wire whisper.cpp as a shared library (`libwhisper.so`) with system OpenBLAS, exposed through layered Rust FFI (`whisper_sys`) and safe API (`whisper_rs`).

Scope
- CMake build via Cargo `build.rs` using `cmake` crate
- System OpenBLAS resolution via pkg-config/CMake
- Bindgen wrapper generation from `whisper.h`
- GTK wiring for startup system info + model load smoke path
- Linkage/runtime validation

Acceptance Criteria
- `cargo clean && cargo build` succeeds on a machine with OpenBLAS installed
- Resulting binary runs and prints Whisper system info
- Smoke test can load model and cleanly free context
- `ldd target/debug/<binary>` shows linkage to `libopenblas.so`
close_reason: All child beads complete and acceptance criteria validated

title: Add Rust build+FFI dependencies for whisper integration
description:
Deliverables
- Update `Cargo.toml` with:
  - `[build-dependencies]` `cmake = "0.1"`, `pkg-config = "0.3"`, `bindgen = "0.69"`
  - `[dependencies]` `libc = "0.2"`
- Ensure dependency graph resolves without version conflicts

Acceptance Criteria
- `cargo check` resolves all new deps successfully
- No non-bun lockfiles or unrelated dependency churn introduced
- Dependency additions match requested versions

title: Implement build.rs to drive whisper.cpp CMake shared build with system OpenBLAS
description:
Deliverables
- Create `build.rs` at repo root
- Configure CMake build for whisper.cpp
- Enable BLAS/OpenBLAS path and prefer system OpenBLAS (pkg-config/CMake find logic)
- Build `libwhisper.so` in Release by default
- Emit Cargo link search/link directives for generated lib and required system libs

Implementation Notes
- Use `cmake` crate as build orchestrator
- Use `pkg-config` to locate OpenBLAS when available
- Keep flags deterministic and CI-friendly

Acceptance Criteria
- `cargo build` triggers CMake build and links `libwhisper.so`
- Build defaults to Release artifacts for whisper CMake build
- On OpenBLAS-capable machine, build resolves against system OpenBLAS (not bundled)

title: Create whisper_sys raw FFI module using bindgen wrapper around whisper.h
description:
Deliverables
- Add `src/whisper_sys/wrapper.h` including `whisper.h`
- Add `src/whisper_sys/mod.rs` exposing generated raw bindings
- Generate `bindings.rs` in `OUT_DIR` from `build.rs` using bindgen
- `include!()` generated bindings in `whisper_sys`

Implementation Constraints
- Keep all C-facing API in `whisper_sys`
- Avoid leaking raw APIs into UI/business modules

Acceptance Criteria
- `cargo build` generates and compiles bindings without manual steps
- `whisper_sys` cleanly exports raw symbols needed for safe wrapper
- No direct `whisper.h` calls outside `whisper_sys`

title: Add safe whisper_rs wrapper layer over whisper_sys
description:
Deliverables
- Create `whisper_rs` module that wraps `whisper_sys` with safe ownership semantics
- Add safe APIs for:
  - `system_info()`
  - `WhisperContext::new(model_path)`
  - Proper context teardown/drop
- Encapsulate unsafe blocks internally and document invariants

Acceptance Criteria
- Safe wrapper compiles with minimal public unsafe surface
- Context lifecycle is deterministic and frees resources cleanly
- Wrapper is the only path used by UI code for Whisper access

title: Wire Whisper smoke path into GTK frontend
description:
Deliverables
- On app startup, call `whisper::system_info()` and log/output result
- Add hidden dev command or button that attempts `WhisperContext::new(model_path)`
- Report success/failure in app-visible way and ensure cleanup after test

Acceptance Criteria
- Running binary prints Whisper system info at startup
- Dev trigger can attempt model load and reports result
- Successful model load path frees context cleanly after smoke test

title: Validate linkage and runtime acceptance for whisper+OpenBLAS integration
description:
Validation Steps
- Run `cargo clean && cargo build` on machine with OpenBLAS installed
- Run app and verify Whisper system info output
- Execute model load smoke-test and verify clean teardown
- Run `ldd target/debug/<binary>` and confirm `libopenblas.so` linkage

Acceptance Criteria
- All validation steps pass and outputs are captured in issue notes/PR summary
- Failures are split into follow-up beads with explicit blockers and evidence
close_reason: Validated acceptance: clean build, runtime system info, model load/free smoke, and openblas linkage confirmed

title: GStreamer: record WAV to temp file
description:
Bead 06 — GStreamer: record WAV to temp file

Goal
- While listening, record to WAV.

Pipeline
- `pipewiresrc ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! wavenc ! filesink location=...`

Deliverables
- `audio/record.rs`:
  - `start(wav_path, on_level)`
  - `stop() -> wav_path`

Definition of Done
- WAV file exists and plays back
- Meter still updates during recording (either via `tee` or separate pipeline)

## Acceptance Criteria
- WAV file exists and plays back
- Meter still updates during recording (either via `tee` or separate pipeline)
acceptance_criteria:
1. WAV file exists after recording and plays back successfully.
2. Meter continues updating during recording (via `tee` or a separate pipeline).
close_reason: Implemented WAV recorder module with live level monitoring and wired UI start/stop flow

title: GStreamer: live mic level meter
description:
Bead 05 — GStreamer: live mic level meter

Goal
- Real mic level drives the meter.

Approach
- GStreamer pipeline (monitor only):
  `pipewiresrc ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! level interval=100000000 ! fakesink`
- Listen for `level` element bus messages, extract peak/RMS

Deliverables
- `audio/monitor.rs`:
  - `start(on_level: Fn(f32))`
  - `stop()`

Definition of Done
- Speaking changes meter smoothly
- Start/stop works repeatedly without crash

## Acceptance Criteria
- Speaking changes meter smoothly
- Start/stop works repeatedly without crash
acceptance_criteria:
1. Speaking changes meter smoothly in real time.
2. Start/stop can be repeated without crashes.

title: Model discovery + config

  - env `ASR_MODEL`
  - `~/.cache/asr-hud/models/`
  - `/usr/share/asr-hud/models/` (optional)

Definition of Done

## Acceptance Criteria
- If model missing: friendly error with exact fix command
acceptance_criteria:
1. If model is missing, the app shows a friendly error.
2. The error includes the exact fix command to resolve it.
